note: Monaco, though outside the EU and not a Schengen signatory, is administered as part of the Schengen Area through France (Convention of 1963): a visitor meets the EU's common list (the eu1806 list).

sources.title: Wikipedia, Schengen Area: territories and European microstates
sources.said: Although Monaco is not an official member of the European Union or a formal signatory to the Schengen Agreement, its territory is administered as an integral part of the Schengen Area.
